scope: coordination metadata only; not production financial records, not factory runtime
registry_id_rule: R{cycle_id}-{sequence_4_digits}; separate from historical report numbers
write_protocol: Fetch this exact file from this branch and keep returned blob SHA.
Read existing receipts and per-cycle sequence; reject duplicate (cycle_id,run_id,deliverable_key) before any write.
Only for material verified change, reserve next per-cycle sequence and append one redacted receipt in a single JSON update_file call using the observed blob SHA.
If GitHub rejects the update due to a stale SHA or concurrency, do not claim success; re-fetch, recheck duplicates, recompute sequence, retry at most 3 times.
After success, re-fetch and ensure exact receipt exists once with the assigned registry_id.
Never use this index alone as proof of live deployment, accepted output, customer payment, or revenue.
report_numbering: Existing 01-NNNN..05-NNNN numbering remains independent and unverified until a conflict-safe legacy migration. Never infer legacy numbers from this registry.
security: Public-safe metadata only; no names of clients, emails, account or wallet addresses, secrets, financial amounts, private documents, contract contents, or personal information.
No messages on project 39. No payments, external sending, publishing, deployment, factory startup, or Remote Desktop Commander.
GitHub is not a runtime dependency of the VPS single-product factory.

legacy_reporting_protocol: Applicable only to cycles with a non-null verified historical last number and an audited canonical issue source.
Do not reserve a historical report number unless a new substantive result with independent evidence is ready to publish.
First fetch canonical issue comments and this registry; if the maximum valid issue report number exceeds the stored verified counter or conflicts exist, halt numbering and reconcile, not guess.
Check the run_id is not already reserved. If reserved, resume exactly that number; never reserve twice for the same run_id.

Atomically increment legacy_report_last_verified and append {cycle_id,run_id,number,state:'reserved'} via GitHub update_file with observed blob SHA; on stale version re-fetch/recheck/retry at most three times.

Only after successfully reading back the reservation, publish the numbered report to the canonical issue, including run_id; if issue write fails leave reservation pending and repair it later. Never reuse reserved number.
Upon success, update reservation to state:'published' with the comment link using another SHA-checked update. A published report is not independently accepted revenue or product.
